title: Dragonmurk

[[Image:Dragonmurk.jpg|thumb|The Dragonmurk]]
'''The Dragonmurk''' is a section of southern [[Dustwallow Marsh]] where [[dragon]] whelps and [[dragonspawn]] of the [[black dragonflight]] are very prolific. Surrounded by the Dragonmurk are [[the Den of Flame]] and the [[Stonemaul Ruins]], both of which are also inhabited by black [[dragonspawn]].
